name: com.blind.uimvvm
description: UI Toolkit MVVM primitives: reactive properties with disposable subscriptions in a standalone Blind.Reactive assembly that carries no UI dependency, a View<TViewModel> base with scope-aware root resolution and automatic teardown, an awaitable screen-navigation stack with ready-made opener bases, awaitable USS transitions, a SafeArea element, an inspector that validates Root Name against the UXML, and audit helpers for the UXML-to-C# links the compiler cannot see. Requires UniTask (com.cysharp.unitask) in the consuming project.
